‘Oud strengthens the mental and spiritual constitution by creating balance, promoting inner peace and personal growth.’ Success and abundance are the result of such a positive mindset.
Its psychoactive properties are used to heal and induce meditation. To experience the high vibrational energy of oud and its benefits, Initio created Oud for Greatness.
Highly concentrated and containing the finest natural oud oil, it is a particularly prestigious oud perfume with an expressive signature.
Oud – for happiness, harmony and healing – Oud for Greatness, a sacred fragrance to feel the heavens and achieve true greatness.
Tree of Life
Sacred geometry is based on powerful symbols that reflect the fundamental forms of nature – from the smallest cell structures to the universe. They can be found in humans, plants, minerals, in everything in creation. They show that everything is connected and represent the divine law of physical manifestation.
Sacred geometry is based on symbols that carry universal energy and strong vibrations. These symbols contain the power of manifestation, which is why they are also called ‘magical symbols’. Based on the principles of sacred geometry, the Tree of Life has the power to create abundance. It symbolises the connection between the fertility of the earth and the heavens. Su perfil aromático resulta adecuado para el uso diario y especialmente atractivo durante las estaciones más templadas.
